style.name: Botanical Midcentury
style.definition: Classic tapered timber furniture surrounded by layered greens and leaf-shaped accents.
style.materials: walnut; fern velvet; cane; terracotta; botanical cotton
style.living: fern-green walnut-leg sofa; walnut cane lounge chair; kidney-shaped walnut coffee table; walnut tapered media console; compact walnut table with four molded timber chairs; cream saucer pendant; bold botanical art
style.bed: walnut spindle queen; ivory linen and fern quilt; walnut nightstands with terracotta lamps
style.solarium: teak outdoor lounge seating with fern performance cushions; teak dining set; generous grouped plants
style.implement: Use a small number of larger plants near glazing and repeat walnut in all main rooms.
style.avoid: Avoid blocking window handles and walkways with pots.
